title: 8 Best Bak Kwa in Singapore (2026): Prices From $10 per 500g Before CNY 2027 - https://www.misslobang.com/
text:
8 Best Bak Kwa in Singapore (2026): Prices From $10 per 500g Before CNY 2027 | MissLobang Miss Lobang Food Deals Lifestyle News Kids 中文 Food 8 Best Bak Kwa in Singapore (2026): Prices From $10 per 500g Before CNY 2027
 Bak kwa in Singapore costs anywhere from $10 to $37.50 for 500g right now, and most brands raise prices in the weeks before Chinese New Year on 6 Feb 2027. We read the prices, CNY ordering rules and live deals of eight bak kwa makers on their own sites on 18 November 2026.
 Sarah Lim 18 November 2026 8 min read Bak kwa prices climb every January, so mid-November is the cheapest time to stock up for Chinese New Year 2027. 
 > Quick view: cheapest is Peng Guan at $10 for 500g ; the famous names run $31 to $37.50 per 500g ; the catch is that CNY prices go up from mid-January (Kim Tee's list already shows $36-$38). 
 1 Lim Chee Guan: the Most Famous Name, $34 for 500g of Signature Sliced Pork
 Lim Chee Guan is the bak kwa most Singaporeans queue for at Chinatown each CNY, grilled thin with a sweet, slightly charred edge. PRICE: Signature Sliced Pork is $20.40 for 300g and $34.00 for 500g . BBQ Chilli Pork is $21.00 / $35.00, Gold Coin Pork $19.20 / $32.00 and BBQ Bacon $33.00 / $55.00. OUTLETS: four , at 203 New Bridge Road (9am-10pm), People's Park Complex #01-25, ION Orchard #B4-37 and Jewel #B2-222. CNY RULES: its FAQ for last new year said only online orders were accepted from one month before to 15 days after CNY, in fixed 500g packs, capped at 20kg per account, and People's Park closed for the rush. The 2027 dates are not out yet, and its menu warns prices may change in the month before the new year. DELIVERY: $20, free from $100. BEST FOR: gifting to older relatives who expect the classic name. 
 Visit website 2 Bee Cheng Hiang: the Biggest Chain, $37.50 for 500g and a 93rd Anniversary Sale
 Bee Cheng Hiang has the widest reach of any bak kwa brand here, so it is the easiest to buy on the way home. PRICE: Signature Sliced Pork is $22.50 for 300g, $37.50 for 500g and $75.00 a kilo ; Minced Pork is also $37.50 for 500g, and Applewood Sliced Pork is $44.00 for 500g (out of stock online when we checked). THE DEAL: its 93rd Anniversary Sale gives a free 100g with 300g of Minced Pork ($22.50) or a free 300g with 700g ($52.50), pork floss at $9.30 for 150g, and a free 165g Crispy Chicken Roll when you spend $80 online. No end date is stated. OUTLETS: more than 40 on its store locator, including 69-71 Pagoda Street, 189 New Bridge Road, Jewel, VivoCity and Paragon. DELIVERY: $8 flat, free from $50, and it may rise during peak periods. BEST FOR: minced pork fans and anyone who wants an outlet near home. 
 93rd Anniversary Sale: Minced Pork buy 300g get 100g free ($22.50) or buy 700g get 300g free ($52.50); pork floss 150g $9.30; free Crispy Chicken Roll 165g with $80 spend. No end date stated.
 Get Deal 3 Kim Tee: Best for Planning CNY, $31 for 500g Now and a Published 2027 Price List
 Kim Tee has grilled bak kwa in Serangoon Garden since 1976 and is the only brand here that has already published its CNY 2027 prices. PRICE NOW: Signature Bak Kwa is $31 for 500g ($62 a kilo) , Chilli $33 and Sliced $34 for 500g. CNY 2027 PRICES: Signature is $36 for 500g if you collect or receive it 18-22 Jan , $37 for 23-27 Jan and $38 from 28 Jan; Chilli runs $38 to $40; Sliced is only sold from 28 Jan at $41. Kim Tee says this is no increase on last CNY. THE DEAL: free delivery with a $60 spend until 17 Jan, plus red packets, a shopping bag and a voucher with every CNY pre-order. FINE PRINT: CNY pre-orders for 18 Jan to 4 Feb need a $228 minimum, delivery is $25 (free from $760) and orders close seven days before your date. OUTLETS: 22 Maju Avenue, Serangoon Garden (10am-8pm Mon-Sat), Old Airport Road Food Centre #01-112 and Toa Payoh Lorong 8 #01-69. BEST FOR: families who like to lock in a price early. 
 Free delivery with $60 spend until 17 Jan 2027. CNY 2027 pre-orders (18 Jan-4 Feb) come with red packets, a Kim Tee bag and a voucher; Signature from $36 per 500g, no increase on last CNY.
 Valid till 17 Jan 2027
 Get Deal 4 Fragrance: Best Value Chain, $18 for 500g of Freshly Grilled Sliced Bak Kwa Online
 Fragrance is the other big chain, and its online shop is where the value is. PRICE: freshly grilled Signature Sliced Tender Bak Kwa is $11.50 for 300g, $18.00 for 500g and $36.00 a kilo , shown against crossed-out prices of $20.40, $34.00 and $68.00. Freshly grilled Gold Coin is $18.70 for 500g, Bacon $35.00 and Premium Kurobuta $35.70 for 450g. Vacuum-packed sliced bak kwa, which keeps longer, is $31.50 for 500g. FINE PRINT: the shop does not say how long the reduced prices last, and its CNY e-voucher page was still empty on 18 November. DELIVERY: free from $68. OUTLETS: 41 , including 205-207 New Bridge Road in Chinatown, Thomson Plaza, VivoCity and Jewel. BEST FOR: buying in bulk for the office or a big family without paying top-name prices. 
 Online price: freshly grilled Sliced Tender Bak Kwa $18 for 500g (shown against $34) or $36 a kilo; free delivery from $68. No end date stated.
 Get Deal 5 Peng Guan: the Cheapest, $10 for 500g at Eight Stalls
 Peng Guan is a heartland bak kwa stall chain, and its price is the lowest we have seen this year. THE DEAL: 500g of Traditional Bak Kwa for $10 (usual $15), and on 18 November its online shop also listed Chilli, Chicken and Sliced at $10 for 500g. The 1kg Traditional pack ($20) was out of stock online. Vacuum packs are $13 for 500g. DATES: Peng Guan's Facebook post said the offer runs to 30 November 2026 ; the shop itself shows no end date. OUTLETS: eight stalls , including Fu Lu Shou Complex #B1-22 (8am-6pm), Ang Mo Kio Ave 6 Blk 720, Kallang Bahru Blk 71 and Jurong West St 41 Blk 496 (7.30am-9pm), plus two in Yishun, one in Bedok North and one in Bukit Panjang. BEST FOR: everyday snacking and stocking up before the CNY price rise. 
 500g Traditional Bak Kwa for $10 (usual $15); Chilli, Chicken and Sliced 500g also $10 online on 18 Nov. Runs to 30 Nov 2026 per Peng Guan's Facebook.
 Valid till 30 Nov 2026
 Get Deal 6 Kim Joo Guan: a Chinatown Classic, $34 for 500g With Free Pickup
 Kim Joo Guan is a smaller Chinatown maker with a thicker, juicier traditional slice. PRICE: Gourmet Traditional Bak Kwa is $34 for 500g and $68 a kilo , Gourmet Chilli $35 / $70, Gold Coin $33 / $66, and a Premium Iberico pack at $108 for 500g. Vacuum-packed traditional is $17 for 200g. ORDERING: its online shop delivers for $20 or lets you pick up free at either store; the earliest slot on 18 November was 21 November. OUTLETS: two , at 257 South Bridge Road (9.30am-7.30pm daily) and Royal Square @ Novena, 103 Irrawaddy Road #01-25. FINE PRINT: no current promotion is listed, and its CNY 2027 ordering details are not out yet. BEST FOR: an Iberico splurge or a Chinatown pickup without the biggest queues. 
 Visit website 7 New Peng Hiang: Most Flavours, $32 for 500g and Duck, Bacon or Truffle Iberico
 New Peng Hiang has made bak kwa since 1984 and has the widest flavour range here. PRICE: Sliced Pork and Tender Pork are $32 for 500g , Pineapple Pork $32, Chilli Sliced $34, Duck $35, Bacon $45 and Truffle Iberico $50. Bak Kwa Bites are $25 for 500g, and Lion City Gold Coin is $6.80 for 80g, a handy small gift. WHERE TO BUY: its own online shop, plus Shopee, Lazada and TikTok Shop; its site lists the Woodlands Loop factory office but no walk-in hours, so order online. FINE PRINT: its discounted gift sets look like last CNY's stock and carry no end date, so we have not counted them as a 2027 deal. BEST FOR: trying something different from plain pork. 
 Visit website 8 Xi Shi Bakkwa: Gift Box Included, $31 for 500g of Hand-Sliced Bak Kwa
 Xi Shi has sold bak kwa since 1985 and packs every 500g order in a gift box with a carrier bag, so it is ready to hand over. THE DEAL: Sliced Meat Bakkwa (spicy or non-spicy) is $31, down from $33 , on its online shop. Original Mince is from $30, and Mushroom Mince, Pineapple Sliced and Mala Mince are $31; the limited-edition Espresso Minced Pork is $32 for 500g. FINE PRINT: the sale prices have no stated end date, and the site's "up to 15% off" banner applies on Shopee, not its own shop. WHERE TO BUY: online, on Shopee, Lazada and TikTok Shop, or at the factory shop at 15 Woodlands Loop #02-37 (10am-5pm weekdays, 10am-1pm Saturdays, closed Sundays and public holidays). BEST FOR: gifts that need to look ready without extra wrapping. 
 Online sale: Sliced Meat Bakkwa $31 for 500g (usual $33), gift box and carrier included. No end date stated.

 How we checked 
 We read every price, outlet list and CNY rule on each brand's own website or online shop on 18 November 2026: Lim Chee Guan's menu, FAQ and outlet pages, Bee Cheng Hiang's product pages, store locator and 93rd anniversary page, Kim Tee's shop and CNY 2027 pre-order menu, Fragrance's online shop and outlet list, Peng Guan's shop and store locations, Kim Joo Guan's online shop and store page, New Peng Hiang's shop, and Xi Shi's shop and contact page. Hu Zhen Long, a well-known Chinatown name, is left out because its website now shows only a placeholder page, so we could not confirm any price. 
 How to buy bak kwa before CNY 
 Buy early if you can freeze it. Kim Tee's 2027 list shows the jump: Signature is $31 for 500g today and $36-$38 in the new year weeks. Lim Chee Guan also warns that prices may change in the month before CNY. 
 Expect online-only ordering at the famous names. Lim Chee Guan only took online orders from a month before to 15 days after last CNY, and Kim Tee closes CNY orders seven days before your slot. Book a slot once dates open instead of planning to walk in. 
 Read the delivery rules. Free delivery starts at $50 (Bee Cheng Hiang), $60 (Kim Tee, to 17 Jan), $68 (Fragrance) and $100 (Lim Chee Guan). Kim Tee's CNY pre-orders also need a $228 minimum. 
 Compare by weight. Most brands sell 500g packs, but some list 300g first, so a lower headline price may simply be a smaller pack.

 Frequently Asked Questions
 How much does bak kwa cost in Singapore in 2026? + Based on prices read on each brand's own site on 18 November 2026, 500g of signature bak kwa costs $10 at Peng Guan, $18 online at Fragrance, $31 at Kim Tee and Xi Shi, $32 at New Peng Hiang, $34 at Lim Chee Guan and Kim Joo Guan, and $37.50 at Bee Cheng Hiang. Prices usually rise in the weeks before Chinese New Year.
 When is the best time to buy bak kwa for Chinese New Year 2027? + Now to early January. Chinese New Year falls on 6 February 2027, and Kim Tee's published CNY list already shows Signature rising from $31 to $36-$38 for 500g between 18 January and the new year. Lim Chee Guan says its prices may change in the month before CNY, and last year it took online orders only during that period.
 Which bak kwa is the cheapest in Singapore? + Peng Guan, at $10 for 500g of Traditional Bak Kwa at its eight stalls and online (its Facebook post says to 30 November 2026). Among the big chains, Fragrance's online shop sells 500g of freshly grilled sliced bak kwa for $18.
 Do I need to queue for Lim Chee Guan bak kwa at CNY? + Last year Lim Chee Guan accepted only online orders from one month before to 15 days after Chinese New Year, in fixed 500g packs with a 20kg limit per account, and its People's Park outlet closed for the rush. The 2027 dates were not published on 18 November 2026, so check its FAQ before you go.
